# [Baseline] - MAC - U - Compliance OS Version

Checks whether the Mac runs macOS 14 or later — the version required by the baseline's declarative update policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | macOS |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Compliance |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own policy; the minimum follows from what the baseline itself already requires — MAC - D - Software Updates uses declarative update policy (DDM) and that requires macOS 14 |
| File | [`Baseline_MAC_U_Compliance_OS_Version.json`](Baseline_MAC_U_Compliance_OS_Version.json) |

> **This value goes stale and must be reviewed.** macOS 14 is the minimum because the update profile requires it, not because 14 is still the latest. Run `node scripts/check-osversion.js` to see how far it lags behind the n-1 version from endoflife.date; that report blocks nothing and should not do so either. Raising it is a decision and therefore a PR — this minimum is a capability floor (see `ondergrens`), so letting it move automatically with n-1 would remove the very reason it is set to 14.
